subject: اللغة الإنجليزية
outcomes: Name old and new ways of communicating
Understand body language and skim a text for the best title
Find words with similar meanings and name their parts of speech

tf.s: Body language means sending a message with movements, gestures or facial expressions.
tf.why: Yes! Our bodies can send messages without words.

tf.s: Printing is one of the new communication technologies in the text.
tf.why: Printing is an older tool; the Internet and mobile phones are new.

tf.s: Skimming means reading quickly to get the general idea of a text.
tf.why: Right! When we skim, we look for the main idea.

tf.s: When you skim, you must read every word slowly.
tf.why: Skimming is fast reading: look at the title, first lines and key words.

tf.s: Police officers and teachers use an understanding of body language in their jobs.
tf.why: Correct! Many jobs need an understanding of body language.

tf.s: The text says that animals use body language too.
tf.why: The text does not mention animals, so this is 'No information'.

tf.s: Someone who is interested in what you say often puts their head on one side.
tf.why: Yes, this is a sign of interest in the text.
'Nervously' is an adverb; it describes how someone does something.
Good! Both are adjectives with a similar meaning.

tf.s: A good title for a text should describe one small detail only.
tf.why: A good title shows the main idea of the whole text.

boxes.q: What is the best title for the body language text?
o: Police Officers Are Doing a Good Job
boxes.why: The text explains what body language is and how it is used.
'Gestures' is a noun: it names things.
'Send' is an action word, so it is a verb.
'We' takes the place of names, so it is a pronoun.

boxes.q: Which word means the same as 'anxiously'?
boxes.why: Both are adverbs with a similar meaning.

boxes.q: What does NG mean in a True / False task?
boxes.why: NG means the text does not say.

boxes.q: Which is a new communication technology?
boxes.why: E-mail is one of the new technologies in the text.

boxes.q: Which is an example of body language?
boxes.why: Nodding sends a message with the body.
'Confused' describes a person, so it is an adjective.

boxes.q: When we skim, what do we look for?
boxes.why: Skimming helps us find the general idea quickly.

hunt.q: Reading quickly for the main idea
Movement of the body to send a message

mcq.q: Which of these is one of the new communication technologies in the text?
mcq.why: Wireless systems are new; the others are older tools.

o: reading quickly to get the general idea
copying a text into your book
mcq.why: Skimming is fast reading for the main idea.

mcq.q: Which jobs does the text say use an understanding of body language?
mcq.why: The text names police officers, teachers and politicians.
'We' takes the place of a noun.

mcq.q: Statement: 'Animals use body language too.' What is the correct answer?
o: NG – the text does not mention animals
mcq.why: If the text does not say it, the answer is NG.

mcq.q: You want a word in the text similar to 'anxiously'. What should you look for first?
mcq.why: A similar word must be the same part of speech.

mcq.q: Rashid walked in slowly, looked at the floor and crossed his arms. Which title fits best?
mcq.why: Walking slowly, no eye contact and crossed arms show nervousness.

mcq.q: Why is 'Police Officers Are Doing a Good Job' not a good title for the text?
o: Police officers are mentioned only briefly
The text is about police uniforms
The text does not mention jobs
mcq.why: The text is about body language in general, not just police.

mcq.q: Why is 'Hidden Messages' less suitable than 'Understanding Body Language'?
o: It does not describe the real topic of the text
mcq.why: The best title tells the main topic clearly.

mcq.q: Why does the text say communication tools have moved human development forward?
o: People can share information and interact from every part of the world
People talk less to each other
mcq.why: Sharing information around the world helps people develop.
